title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 40
paragraphs: These are the parts of Asia extending westwards from the Persian land. As for what lies beyond the Persians, Medes, Saspeirians, and Colchians, towards the east and the sunrise, on one side the Erythraian Sea runs along by them, and on the north both the Caspian Sea and the river Araxes, which flows towards the rising sun. Asia is inhabited as far as the Indian land; but from there onwards to the east it becomes desert, nor can any one say what kind of land it is.
